svg.text: P2 — DATA, FACT LEDGER, EVIDENCE & DECISIONTRACE ARCHITECTURE
Make every material fact, evidence object, artifact version and decision reconstructable while keeping domain ownership explicit and derived data subordinate.
Numbering, naming and event linkage corrected.
Items marked FIXED changed in this edition.
Append provenance and transactional outbox atomically.
DecisionTrace links input artifact versions, facts, rule release,
model/solver refs, reasons/confidence, validity and supersession.
P6 transports events; P2 persists source/event lineage where required.
Revalidation triggers fire on expiry/material updates.
Derived indexes rebuilt from source/event history
FactLedger does not mean all domain tables collapse into one store.
P6 owns event transport, not P2.
P2-G1 · Provider license expiry triggers revalidation
P2-G2 · Fact update preserves superseded value
P2-G3 · Search index stale but authoritative eligibility recheck
Board regenerated from the corrected canonical set. Text is real SVG text — readable by script, not only by eye.
Every consumed event on this board has exactly one producer, or is declared external. Open rulings are listed in the canonical file, not decided here.
